purpose: Keep media within a predictable proportional area.
avoid: The ratio does not supply a text alternative or image loading policy.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The image alt conveys the meaningful media subject; a decorative image instead gets empty alt in its own context.
updatesAndDescendants: The wrapper sets CSS --ratio from a required number and rerenders children on prop updates. It does not load, crop, label or announce media automatically. This reference requires a finite positive ratio as a caller precondition.
referenceDecision: Positive ratio and meaningful alt are caller requirements. The upstream function itself supplies no runtime ratio validation.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: The actual wrapper sets --ratio from its required number prop. Caller precondition is finite positive ratio; there is no invented runtime validation/default. Native384×216 is one16:9 specimen, not a fixed output width.10px clipped corners and gray/6 preview surface retain observed visual values; the neutral surface is deliberately fixed rather than pretending it is a theme mode. Source docs explicitly show16:9,1:1 and9:16 examples and caller object-cover media. This reference adopts cover cropping with meaningful alt; the small vector image is independently authored test media, not native kit imagery. Intrinsic parent width controls both dimensions; child loading and announcements remain caller-owned.
